snippet.title: Lou's Lagoon | Official Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Take flight in your trusty seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After a devastating storm, gather materials with your Swirler 2000, and help the locals rebuild. Can you uncover the truth behind Uncle Lou’s disappearance? 

🌴 Explore the Limbo archipelago, home to vibrant communities and ancient secrets. 
🛩️ Pilot your very own seaplane, master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 
🌀Upgrade your gadgets to expand your adventures. Scoop, build, glide and fish! 
🛠️Personalize your seaplane with vibrant skins and custom configurations. 
🎨 Full character customization. Make your avatar uniquely yours, from hairstyle to outfits and accessories. 
🛠️ Build your island base, decorate it, and make Lou’s Lagoon feel like home. 
❔A mystery to unravel. Piece together clues, follow Lou’s trail, and uncover the truth behind his disappearance! 

Soaring onto PC, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S later this year!
